messages:
maria: heads-up — I pushed an experimental per-org token-latency grafana panel (scopes by workspace_id + route). noticed repeated p99 spikes for workspace=org_42 since ~10:12 UTC. can someone eyeball the aggregation logic?
kevin: where are the spikes most visible? total request latency or per-token decode?
maria: token-level breakdown shows decoder_token_ms dominating for those traces. encoder and tokenize are stable. kv_fetch_ms has a bump too. attaching the query I used:
```
sum by (workspace_id, route, le) (increase(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))
```
sam: ops-bot fired an alert earlier: "tenant org_42 tail-latency > 500ms" — I can pull flamegraphs if helpful. did we roll any kernel-selector changes yesterday?
maria: yes, runtime rolled a small kernel-ranking tweak at ~02:00 UTC (optimize for short sequences). wondering if that harms longer prompts / cache locality.
ops-bot: alert: tenant=org_42 tail_latency_p99 > 500ms (3/5) — see incident #INC-2026-0912
kevin: ok — two hypotheses: 1) kernel selection chooses a kernel with worse batching behavior for long seqs, increasing per-token kernel_exec_ms; 2) kv cache miss rate increased leading to more slow kv_fetch_ms per request. maria — can you paste a sample trace?
maria: pasted a 6-line trace (redacted):
```
span: request.start
span: tokenize (3ms)
span: kv_fetch (78ms)  <-- cold miss spike
span: kernel_exec (42ms per token)
span: batch_wait (9ms)
span: response.end
```
julia: from a dashboard perms perspective we also need to be careful — current grafana panels expose workspace_id as a filter but developers can still see all workspace rows if they have OrgViewer role. we should gate per-route org-scoped KPIs so non-admins only see their workspace.
kevin: agree. technical notes: adding workspace_id as a label on high-cardinality histograms will blow up cardinality. plan: emit base histograms without workspace label to main prometheus, and emit a sampled org_metrics stream (remote write) with workspace_id for workspace-level dashboards. exemplars on spans will help trace linking.
sam: for immediate mitigation, can we add a temporary runtime override: force kernel-selector to use kernel=A for routes matching /generate-long until we validate? avoids revert of whole roll.
maria: I can push a canary override for route filter; will also add a small panel that breaks token_latency into: tokenize_ms, kv_fetch_ms, kernel_exec_ms, batch_wait_ms (p50/p90/p99 + count).
julia: ops: add RBAC ticket to restrict grafana dashboards: only admins and SREs can see all workspaces, product devs get workspace-scoped views.
kevin: i'll instrument kv_hit_rate gauge and a kv_latency histogram with workspace_id only in remote-write stream. also add a tiny batching heuristic metric: batch_size_distribution and batch_wait_ms to surface increased batching windows.
maria: action list: 1) maria -> push dashboard filters + canary kernel override (ETA 30m); 2) kevin -> PR for kv metrics + exemplars (ETA 2h); 3) sam -> flamegraph + attach traces to INC-2026-0912 (ETA 1h); 4) julia -> create RBAC ticket (ETA EOD).
sam: noted, i'll attach a couple of raw traces and one flamegraph to the incident.
kevin: if we confirm correlation with kernel change i'll prepare a fast revert patch but prefer targeted override first. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks everyone. i'll post updates in this thread as I roll the override.
